entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: The 228-aa sequence has a Ham1p_like Pfam domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 7–213, i-Evalue 1.4e-55.
Closest reviewed homologs are dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases B7GN27, B8DVS6, and B3DTK7, with 57.9–59.8% identity and approximately 92% query coverage.
The protein is predicted soluble, approximately 24.2 kDa, with theoretical pI 6.07; no signal peptide or transmembrane segment was reported.
Function assignment is based primarily on strong sequence homology and domain evidence, not direct biochemical testing of this query sequence.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed homologs catalyze hydrolysis of XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphates plus diphosphate.
The enzyme is annotated as EC 3.6.1.66, binds one Mg2+ per subunit, and forms a homodimer.
GO annotations include dITP diphosphatase activity, ITP diphosphatase activity, XTP diphosphatase activity, cytosolic localization, and purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism.

entities.name: Noncanonical purine nucleotide sanitization
observations: Hydrolysis of dITP, ITP, and XTP removes potentially mutagenic noncanonical purine nucleotides from the nucleotide pool and may reduce their incorporation into DNA or RNA.
